english.name: Treasure Hunter
english.description: Find all secret items in every level

schinese.name: 宝藏猎人
schinese.description: 找到每个关卡中的所有秘密物品。

english.name: What a View!
english.description: Build a tower with at least 12 Wizard-created objects and stand on top of the tower without collapsing it

schinese.name: 风景真好！
schinese.description: 用至少 12 个法师创造的物体建造一座塔，并站在塔顶且不让它倒塌。

english.name: Whoops!
english.description: Kill 5 monsters (or 3 in Enchanted Edition) with a single physical object drop or throw

schinese.name: 哎呀！
schinese.description: 用单次物理物体坠落或投掷击杀 5 个怪物（或在 Enchanted Edition 中击杀 3 个）。

english.name: Better Than Developers!
english.description: Complete Tower of Sarek without any deaths on hardest difficulty (Hardcore mode not required)

schinese.name: 胜过开发者！
schinese.description: 以最高难度完成 Tower of Sarek 且不死亡（不要求 Hardcore 模式）。

english.name: The Cool Way
english.description: In a single level, kill one monster by jumping on it with the Knight, one with the Wizard's abilities and one with the Thief's grappling hook kick

schinese.name: 酷炫方式
schinese.description: 在单个关卡中，用骑士跳踩击杀一个怪物，用法师能力击杀一个怪物，并用盗贼抓钩踢击杀一个怪物。

english.name: Survivalist
english.description: Survive a level other than Astral Academy without any damage

schinese.name: 生存专家
schinese.description: 在 Astral Academy 以外的关卡中不受任何伤害并生还。

english.name: Dead on arrival
english.description: Complete a level with 25 or more character deaths

schinese.name: 到场即死
schinese.description: 以 25 次或更多角色死亡完成一个关卡。

english.name: Still no fireball
english.description: Conjure 200 objects in a single level

schinese.name: 还是没有火球
schinese.description: 在单个关卡中召唤 200 个物体。

english.name: Undead have rights, too!
english.description: Complete a level other than Astral Academy without directly killing any enemies

schinese.name: 亡灵也有权利！
schinese.description: 在 Astral Academy 以外的关卡中不直接击杀任何敌人并完成关卡。

english.name: Spring master
english.description: Complete at least 5 jumps (or 3 in Enchanted Edition) in a row on different skeletons without touching the ground

schinese.name: 弹跳大师
schinese.description: 在不触地的情况下连续踩不同骷髅完成至少 5 次跳跃（或在 Enchanted Edition 中 3 次）。

english.name: Way Out of the Trine
english.description: Earn all Achievements in Trine

schinese.name: 走出 Trine
schinese.description: 获得 Trine 中的所有成就。

english.name: Summer Dip
english.description: Stay underwater for more than 20 seconds without taking damage

schinese.name: 夏日潜水
schinese.description: 在水下停留超过 20 秒且不受伤害。

english.name: Winter Secrets
english.description: Find the Academic, Bony and Crystalline holiday secret gifts.

schinese.name: 冬日秘密
schinese.description: 找到 Academic、Bony 和 Crystalline 节日秘密礼物。

english.name: Enchanted
english.description: Launch the Enchanted Edition of the game

schinese.name: Enchanted
schinese.description: 启动游戏的 Enchanted Edition。
